Do not submit a hand-composed grid.
3. Run the transform on every received input/output pair and compare complete grids exactly. Preserve demos as received; never use a sparse reconstruction or hand-derived expected output, since transcription errors can masquerade as rule failures. After each code edit, rerun every pair; an exception or mismatch means the program is not validated, so do not submit yet. Once all pairs match and the test result passes these checks, submit only that returned grid.  "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The full-width/full-height divider lines partition the grid into panels.
    row_divs = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if row and all(x == row[0] and x != 0 for x in row)]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] != 0 and g[r][c] == g[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # Use the recurring divider value; ignore any accidental full lines otherwise.
    row_sep = row_divs
    col_sep = col_divs
    r_bounds = [-1] + row_sep + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + col_sep + [w]
    panels = [(r_bounds[i] + 1, r_bounds[i+1], c_bounds[j] + 1, c_bounds[j+1])
              for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1) for j in range(len(c_bounds)-1)]
    nr, nc = len(r_bounds)-1, len(c_bounds)-1
    # The first panel column encodes the color assigned to each panel row.
    colors = []
    for i in range(nr):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = panels[i*nc]
        vals = [g[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if g[r][c] != 0]
        if not vals:
            raise ValueError('missing row color marker')
        colors.append(vals[0])
    # One non-marker panel contains the motif; copy its occupied cells to every panel.
    motif = None
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(1, nc):
            r0, r1, c0, c1 = panels[i*nc+j]
            pts = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if g[r][c] != 0]
            if pts:
                motif = pts
                break
        if motif is not None:
            break
    if motif is None:
        raise ValueError('missing motif')
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            r0, r1, c0, c1 = panels[i*nc+j]
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    g[r][c] = 0
            for dr, dc in motif:
                g[r0+dr][c0+dc] = colors[i]
    return g
"
}
